note: Expected-fail properties for scripts/props.test.ts. Each needs a reason; it reports in the eval-gate comment but does not fail. When the fix lands (#103 for the size formats, #90 for abacus rods) the suite prints STALE: delete the entry in that PR or right after.

expectedFail.name: size: mixed fractions (24 1/2)
expectedFail.reason: fixed by #103 (class-size-parse, I35): "24 1/2" is read as 2 on main

expectedFail.name: size: unicode fractions (24½)
expectedFail.reason: fixed by #103 (class-size-parse, I35): "24½" is not read as 24 1/2 on main ("bookcase 30½ wide 60 tall" builds 60 wide)

expectedFail.name: size: hyphen fractions (24-1/2)
expectedFail.reason: fixed by #103 (class-size-parse, I35): "24-1/2" is read as 2 on main

expectedFail.name: size: feet-inches (2' 6", 2 ft 6 in)
expectedFail.reason: fixed by #103 (class-size-parse, I35): feet-inches are not read on main ("bookcase 2' 6\" wide 60 tall" builds 60 wide)

expectedFail.name: size: W×D×H strings with fractions
expectedFail.reason: fixed by #103 (class-size-parse, I35): fractions inside W×D×H strings ("30 1/2x12x60") are misread on main

expectedFail.name: count: abacus rods built or refused
expectedFail.reason: Typed-count rule (#90, Critic regrade at 90c0deb): main silently builds fewer rods than typed ("abacus 10 wide 15 rods" → 12); #90 builds the count or refuses with the minimum width
